text:
Claire (Mktg): Hey team, tight ask for next launch wave — need a compact creative + ops handoff. Drafts in 24h, final in 48h. Deliverables list: 1) mobile-first benchmark micro-grid (3 cols: Latency p50, Cost/1k, 8-word quality note) with tiny sparklines; 2) social cards (1200x628 & 1080x1080) with two CTA variants for A/B; 3) webinar hero + single TL;DR slide; 4) email header (light/dark); 5) editable inbound routing diagram (SVG) showing canary split + where telemetry and rollbacks live; 6) one-page brand & localization checklist plus strings CSV. Keep everything legal-safe and mobile-friendly.

Owen (Design): On it. Qs: sparklines static PNGs vs SVG animation? hero photo vs illustration? preferred font tokens?

Claire (Mktg): Static PNG sparklines OK; include optional SVG for animation. Illustration for hero to match benchmarks. Use Inter; weights: 600 for model, 400 for copy.

Maya (Growth): CTA variants: "See the numbers" and "Compare latency & cost". Make CTA a separate component in Figma so we can swap text in ads. Provide 1x and 2x exports.

Priya (PMM): Legal notes: anonymize model names ("Model A/B/C"). No competitor logos or superlative claims without footnote. Include alt-text for every image and contrast ratios in checklist. Localization: CSV with key,en,de,jp and notes on typical expansion % and truncation guidance. Small disclaimer text: "Representative workloads; results may vary."

Owen (Design): Deliverables I'll upload: Figma page link + PNG/2x exports + SVG editable diagram + PDF checklist + strings CSV. Specs: micro-grid row 36px mobile, sparklines 60x12, social sizes 1200x628 & 1080x1080, hero 1600x900, TL;DR 1024x576, email header 600x200. CTA safe zone 16px.

Claire (Mktg): Micro-grid notes: bold model name, one-line quality note <=8 words, winner highlight single color chip (no star icons), tiny legend. Mobile legibility is highest priority. Add a tooltip layer in Figma with raw numbers and source notes.

Maya (Growth): For routing diagram: show path: client webhook -> Redwood Hosted API -> Canary split -> Dedicated fallback -> notify Ops (email + Slack). Label canary presets 5%/20%/50% and mark where automatic rollback triggers and telemetry hooks (sampling).

Owen (Design): Will include that. Naming for exports: launch_5043216789/{asset}_{size}_{variant}.png and diagram as SVG. DesignOps Bot: tag upload path?

DesignOps Bot: Reminder — upload drafts to /shared/launch-assets/5043216789/drafts/ and finals to /shared/launch-assets/5043216789/final/. Tag: "microbench-5043". Set permissions: marketing+growth+design.

Priya (PMM): Also add headshot spec: circular 96px, export at 2x, include alt-text template.

Claire (Mktg): OK — drafts in 24h. Please ping @Maya and me when Figma drafts are live so we can quick review before finalizing. Thanks everyone! :sparkles:
